```python
import os
import math
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

# Directory setup
output_dir = r"C:\Users\renu5\Downloads\stickman_master_asset"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

width, height = 1920, 1080
bg_color = "#00FF00" # Neon green

def draw_blackboard(draw):
    # Board outer frame
    board_rect = [(200, 100), (1400, 700)]
    draw.rectangle(board_rect, fill="#2c3e50", outline="#8B4513", width=20)
    # Chalk tray
    draw.rectangle([(180, 700), (1420, 730)], fill="#8B4513")
    
def draw_happy_face(draw, cx, cy, radius):
    # Head
    draw.ellipse([(cx-radius, cy-radius), (cx+radius, cy+radius)], fill="white", outline="black", width=5)
    # Eyes
    eye_radius = 5
    draw.ellipse([(cx-20-eye_radius, cy-15-eye_radius), (cx-20+eye_radius, cy-15+eye_radius)], fill="black")
    draw.ellipse([(cx+20-eye_radius, cy-15-eye_radius), (cx+20+eye_radius, cy-15+eye_radius)], fill="black")
    # Happy mouth
    bbox = [(cx-25, cy-10), (cx+25, cy+30)]
    draw.arc(bbox, start=0, end=180, fill="black", width=5)

def draw_stickman(draw, frame_idx, total_frames):
    # Base coordinates
    head_x, head_y = 1600, 450
    head_r = 60
    
    # Body
    neck_y = head_y + head_r
    pelvis_y = neck_y + 250
    draw.line([(head_x, neck_y), (head_x, pelvis_y)], fill="black", width=10)
    
    # Legs
    left_foot = (head_x - 80, pelvis_y + 250)
    right_foot = (head_x + 80, pelvis_y + 250)
    draw.line([(head_x, pelvis_y), left_foot], fill="black", width=10)
    draw.line([(head_x, pelvis_y), right_foot], fill="black", width=10)
    
    # Left Arm (hanging down)
    shoulder_y = neck_y + 40
    left_hand = (head_x + 100, shoulder_y + 150)
    draw.line([(head_x, shoulder_y), left_hand], fill="black", width=10)
    
    # Right Arm (pointing at the board, animated)
    # The animation will move the hand up and down slightly while pointing at the board.
    # Frame index goes from 0 to 89
    
    # Angle calculation (smooth back and forth motion)
    angle_offset = math.sin((frame_idx / total_frames) * 2 * math.pi) * 25 # degrees
    
    base_angle = -150 # pointing towards the board (left and up)
    current_angle = base_angle + angle_offset
    
    arm_length = 220
    rad = math.radians(current_angle)
    right_hand_x = head_x + arm_length * math.cos(rad)
    right_hand_y = shoulder_y + arm_length * math.sin(rad)
    
    draw.line([(head_x, shoulder_y), (right_hand_x, right_hand_y)], fill="black", width=10)
    
    # Draw Head with happy face
    draw_happy_face(draw, head_x, head_y, head_r)
    

for i in range(90):
    img = Image.new("RGB", (width, height), bg_color)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    
    draw_blackboard(draw)
    draw_stickman(draw, i, 90)
    
    # Save frame
    frame_number = i + 1
    filename = f"frame_{frame_number:03d}.png"
    filepath = os.path.join(output_dir, filename)
    img.save(filepath)

print("Finished generating frames.")
```
